points.description: States perpetual (terminal/long-term) growth rate as one of the two factors.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only a vague 'growth rate' or 'growth' is given without terminal/perpetual sense.

points.description: States WACC / discount rate (cost of capital) as the other factor.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only vague 'interest rate' or 'cost of capital' wording that is close but imprecise.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each of the two required items: perpetual/terminal growth rate and WACC/discount rate. Accept clear synonyms (terminal growth, long-term growth; cost of capital, discount rate). Order does not matter; a wrong or unrelated item earns nothing for that blank, and does not affect the other.
